inspiration.observed_pattern: A CUBE report projects GROUPING flags plus GROUPING_ID masks in both argument orders, making subtotal level and bit significance observable alongside aggregate totals.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a campaign-sales cube report. MariaDB-compatible UNION ALL branches emit detail, channel subtotal, promotion subtotal, and grand-total rows with explicit grouping flags and the corresponding two argument-order bitmasks; the source schema, values, filter, and Oracle syntax are not copied.

fixture_notes: Four campaign sales rows produce four detail rows, two channel subtotals, three promotion subtotals, and one grand total. The two grouping-ID columns deliberately reverse their bit significance to expose argument order.
determinism_notes: Campaign IDs, channel IDs, promotion IDs, amounts, summary masks, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE campaign_sales_masks (sale_id INT PRIMARY KEY, channel_id INT NOT NULL, promo_id INT NOT NULL, amount_cents INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT channel_id, promo_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS total_cents, 0 AS grouping_channel, 0 AS grouping_promo, 0 AS grouping_id_channel_promo, 0 AS grouping_id_promo_channel FROM campaign_sales_masks WHERE promo_id > 496 GROUP BY channel_id, promo_id UNION ALL SELECT channel_id, NULL, SUM(amount_cents), 0, 1, 1, 2 FROM campaign_sales_masks WHERE promo_id > 496 GROUP BY channel_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL, promo_id, SUM(amount_cents), 1, 0, 2, 1 FROM campaign_sales_masks WHERE promo_id > 496 GROUP BY promo_id UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, SUM(amount_cents), 1, 1, 3, 3 FROM campaign_sales_masks WHERE promo_id > 496 ORDER BY channel_id, promo_id, total_cents, grouping_channel

checks.sql: SELECT sale_id, channel_id, promo_id, amount_cents FROM campaign_sales_masks ORDER BY sale_id
